newsitem.title: FRANCE: SocGen sets 5.0 bln FFr OAT/TEC options.
newsitem.headline: SocGen sets 5.0 bln FFr OAT/TEC options.

text.p: Societe Generale Acceptance NV is issuing 5.0 billion francs of options, allowing the exchange of the 6.50 percent OAT due October 25 2006 against the TEC 10 OAT due October 2006, lead manager Societe Generale, Paris said.
It said the European Call options were exercisable either on October 20, 1998 or October 19, 1999.
There will be 2.5 million options of a nominal price of 2,000 francs with an issue price of 2.80 percent, or 56 francs, it said.

"Societe Generale will ensure a liquid secondary market on these options...and a typical bid-ask spread of five percent of the price of the option, with a minimum 20 basis points, or 4.00 francs," it said. -- Paris Newsroom +33 1 4221 5452
